subject: Culture
title: Sacred Animals
description: A quick, practical guide to Sacred Animals.

hook.text: Cows wander Indian highways untouched. In ancient Egypt, killing a cat was punishable by death.

buildup.text: Sacred animals reflect what a culture depends on. Cattle gave milk and labor. Cats killed vermin.

discovery.text: Hindus revere cows as symbols of the earth's generosity. Cow slaughter is illegal in most Indian states.

twist.text: The bald eagle is sacred to Native Americans but became America's symbol—claimed by those who displaced them.

climax.text: A sacred animal is a mirror. It shows what a society values enough to protect.

punchline.text: Tell me what you won't kill and I'll know your gods.

quiz.question: In ancient Egypt, killing which animal could be punished by death?
